title: Prevention of urinary catheter-associated infections by coating antimicrobial peptides from crowberry endophytes

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/database rows were source-reviewed; supplementary landing pages were checked and did not expose structured supplement tables locally.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the Table 1/Table 2 MIC extraction and row-level database adjudication from local XML/PDF/database sources; remaining issues are caution-level and no blocking rework target remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/CAMP rows were reconciled record-by-record against Table 1, Table 2, stability text, sequence/synthesis text, and article metadata. Baseline/range rows are source_verified; doubled ATCC rows without condition metadata remain source_conflict with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 and Table 2 were re-parsed into 52 source-located MIC rows with units, species/strain or isolate labels, and assay context. Blank yeast fifth-isolate cells are preserved as unreported rather than fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Automated pending-review mechanism notes were replaced with bounded source-reviewed claims separating direct Live/Dead/CFU surface killing evidence from inferred electrostatic adhesion and surface-immobilization context.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Eight linked DBAASP rows report doubled ATCC MIC values without row-level condition metadata; these remain source_conflict, not source_verified.
Local XML Table 2 lacks fifth-isolate values for C. glabrata and C. parapsilosis; no fifth value is invented.

Local supplementary landing-*.bin files are article HTML landing pages and no structured supplementary tables are locally recoverable; owner-layer gate-changing evidence is present in XML/PDF/database artifacts.
Mechanism record uses text-supported killing percentages and assay limitations; exact image/bar values not stated in local text are not fabricated.
